instructions.intro: Set the system prompt used for every task. Markdown is supported.
instructions.persona_hint: Who this agent is when it replies in chat. The inbound coordinator uses this for voice only; it does not change whether a message becomes an Issue.
instructions.persona_placeholder: You are a reliable teammate. State the facts first, then a brief suggestion.

instructions.tone_placeholder: Short sentences. No small talk. Do not repeat the user.
instructions.extract_empty: Write instructions first, then extract persona and tone.

colleague.label: Teammate
colleague.text: You are a reliable teammate. State facts first, then a brief suggestion. Do not over-promise.

advisor.label: Advisor
advisor.text: You are a specialist advisor. Lead with the conclusion, then one or two reasons. Skip ceremony.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.text: You are an action-taking assistant. Skip greetings. Name the next step or the thing you will check.

coordinator.label: Coordinator
coordinator.text: You are a calm coordinator. Align people and facts. Do not take sides. Make the matter explicit.

direct.label: Direct
direct.text: Short sentences. No small talk. Do not repeat the user's words.

warm.label: Warm professional
warm.text: Polite and restrained. Sound like a work message, not a chatbot.

casual.label: Casual teammate
casual.text: Spoken and natural, like a DingTalk DM with a colleague. Stay useful.

formal.label: Formal written
formal.text: Precise wording. No exaggeration. Suitable for a manager or another team.

instructions.placeholder:
Define this agent's role, expertise, and working style.

# Example
You are a frontend engineer specializing in React and TypeScript.

## Working Style
- Write small, focused PRs — one commit per logical change
- Prefer composition over inheritance
- Always add unit tests for new components

## Constraints
- Do not modify shared/ types without explicit approval
- Follow the existing component patterns in features/
instructions.system_layer_hint: Updates with each Multica release. You can't edit it, and your notes below are never overwritten.
instructions.workspace_notes_intro: Add your team's context and preferences below. They apply on top of the instructions Multica maintains for this agent. Markdown is supported.
instructions.workspace_notes_placeholder:
Add context this agent should always have.

# Example
Our main repository is github.com/acme/platform.
Write issues in English even when we chat in Chinese.
We do not deploy on Fridays.

dispatch.scope_body: Only to work that arrives from an external channel. Issues and chats you create inside Multica never receive it. Older runtimes that do not support a separate instruction field get the policy prepended to the task content instead.
dispatch.condition_dingtalk_dispatch: Injected for DingTalk messages, calendar events and approval events dispatched to this agent. Independent Issue tasks the Coordinator creates from those events do not receive it.
dispatch.condition_per_dispatch: Resolved by the router for each dispatch — the conversation, message and sender it must reply to. Independent Issue tasks the Coordinator creates do not receive it.
dispatch.condition_dingtalk_conversation: Injected for DingTalk conversations — the conversation is the source of truth, plus the commands that read it and any quoted message back.
dispatch.condition_dingtalk_channel: Injected for DingTalk channel messages — recall and bind the Issue to openConversationId.
dispatch.condition_any_dingtalk_task: Injected for every DingTalk task, including ones that arrive without a dispatch envelope.
dispatch.condition_enterprise_runtime: Injected only when the agent runs on an enterprise-identity runtime.
dispatch.assembled_hint: The segments above, joined in order — this is the text the agent receives.

dsh_home.shared_intro: This is the workspace shared disk. Set it to none, read, or write for this agent. It is not the employee private disk at /mnt/multica, and it is not a DSH setting. After read or write, the next task mounts it at /mnt/workspace/shared. This grant does not change private-disk access or the DSH profile.

DSH_HOME=/mnt/multica/home, and installed plugin builds live in /mnt/multica/plugin-builds. The shared disk above is not on this disk.

routines.title: Routines
routines.subtitle: Have the agent do something here on a schedule or when a webhook request arrives. Each run posts a start and an end message in this chat.
routines.read_only: Only agent managers can change routines here. You can also ask the agent to set one up in the chat.
routines.empty_hint: For example, sum up open to-dos every weekday morning, or summarize changes when a deploy finishes. The agent uses this chat's configuration and tells everyone here when it starts and finishes.
routines.not_scene_title: Routines belong to a group chat or a 1:1 chat
routines.not_scene_hint: Pick a group chat or a 1:1 chat to manage its routines.
routines.rhythm_webhook: Runs when a webhook request arrives
routines.run_started: Run started. The result will be posted in this chat
routines.rotate_description: The old URL stops working right away. Systems that call it need the new one.
routines.delete_description: It won't run again. Its run history is kept.
routines.updated_existing: This chat already has a routine with the same purpose and schedule. Its instructions were updated
routines.editor_description: On every run the agent follows the instructions and uses this chat's prompts, skills and connectors.
routines.field_instructions_placeholder: Say what to do on each run and what the result should include
routines.field_instructions_hint: The result is posted in this chat as the end message, so there's no need to ask for that here.
routines.webhook_create_hint: Creating it generates a dedicated URL. A POST request to it starts a run and hands the request body to the agent.
routines.webhook_edit_hint: Editing doesn't change the webhook URL. Use “Regenerate webhook URL” to get a new one.
routines.webhook_reveal_description: The full URL is shown only this once, so copy it now. Anyone with it can trigger this routine. Treat it like a password.
routines.error_identity: The agent has no DingTalk identity in this organization, so it can't post results here.
routines.error_dm_target: There's no message from the other person in this 1:1 chat yet. Ask them to message the agent first.
routines.error_runtime: The agent has no runtime, so routines can't run.
routines.error_duplicate: This chat already has a routine with the same purpose and schedule.
routines.error_paused: Enable this routine before running it.
routines.error_manager_only: Only agent managers can change routines.
routines.error_generic: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

tag_page.adopt_title: Add an existing agent as a tenant
tag_page.adopt_description: For an agent that is already connected to DingTalk. The next apply replaces its shared configuration with the Tag's.
tag_page.apply_description: Template changes are published as a new revision first, then applied to the selected tenants: instructions, skills, connectors, MCP, DSH plugins, runtime and model. tag_page.archive_employee_hint: Unbinds its DingTalk digital employee; it stops taking work.
tag_page.keep_employee_hint: The agent, its digital employee binding and its scenes stay as an ordinary agent.
tag_page.title: Tag
tag_page.tenants_empty_hint: Each tenant is an enterprise served by its own digital employee.

tag_tenant.identity_hint: Which DingTalk identity this tenant's digital employee works as, and where its messages and events come from.
tag_tenant.issue_hint: Give the digital employee a DingTalk identity: scan, or fill in its IDs.
tag_tenant.method_scan_hint: The digital employee confirms by scanning in DingTalk.
tag_tenant.method_fill_hint: Enter the digital employee's and supervisor's IDs (org-scoped, not CorpIDs).
tag_tenant.fill_operator_only: Only platform operators can fill in an identity.
tag_tenant.fill_uid: Digital employee userId (in-org ID, as DEAP reports it)
tag_tenant.fill_deap_agent: DEAP employee ID (required with a supervisor)
tag_tenant.tip_supervisor: The UID of the person who supervises this employee: the UID a scanned identity card shows after the supervisor binds it (a global ID, for example 6753994909). It differs from the supervisor's userId within the organization.
tag_tenant.tip_profile: With several DingTalk accounts signed in locally, add --profile <supervisor corpId:userId> to the command.
tag_tenant.tip_uid_check: The second command prints the value to enter, for example "858957531". Do not enter the global UID from a scanned identity card: the cloud exchange checks DEAP's userId and fails when they differ.
tag_tenant.tip_uid: The employee's userId is usually not shown anywhere. Read it from its DEAP profile with the supervisor's dws on your machine: find the agentUuid, then read the userId.
tag_tenant.tip_deap: The employee's agentUuid in DEAP. Run this with the supervisor's dws on your machine and find it by name:
tag_tenant.tip_org: The organization's numeric OrgID, not the CorpID that starts with ding. A scanned identity card shows it; it is the same for everyone in the organization.
tag_tenant.fill_ids_note: The OrgID and the employee userId are numeric IDs within the organization; the OrgID is not a CorpID. With a supervisor, incoming messages are fetched by exchanging the supervisor's ticket for the employee (DEAP), and the exchange checks that DEAP's userId matches this one. The ? next to each field shows how to find it.
tag_tenant.fill_supervisor_needs_deap: A supervisor UID also needs the DEAP employee ID.
tag_tenant.perceive_hint: How the digital employee receives DingTalk messages and events. Native and backend subscription are mutually exclusive.
tag_tenant.mode_native_hint: Subscribes to DingTalk messages with the employee's own identity, without a message route. Turning it on also turns on inbound judgment and managed DingTalk replies.
tag_tenant.mode_backend_hint: Scan to bind a message route; the backend Router forwards DingTalk messages to the employee.
tag_tenant.mode_a2a_hint: DEAP hands events to the employee over the A2A protocol.
tag_tenant.native_blocked_by_route: A backend subscription is bound; unbind it first
tag_tenant.route_blocked_by_native: Native is on; turn it off first
tag_tenant.qr_hint: Scan with the DingTalk digital employee account that will be {{agent}}.
tag_tenant.bundle_hint: The skills, connectors and hosted credentials here make up the Tag's default access bundle: every tenant inherits it, and each enterprise, group or person can switch on more of what is published to scenes.
tag_tenant.outside_employee_banner: The employee agent of Tag tenant {{name}}. Its configuration is inherited from the Tag and is read-only here.
tag_tenant.outside_template_banner: The Tag's shared configuration. Every tenant inherits it; manage tenants on the Tag page.
tag_tenant.level_bundle_hint: Inherits the Tag's default access bundle (shared skills, connectors and hosted credentials). Switch on more of what is published to scenes, or host this level's own credentials.
tag_tenant.supervisor_link: Supervisor exchange: supervisor UID {{supervisor}} · DEAP employee {{deap}}
tag_tenant.stream_unavailable: This deployment has no native subscription service
tag_tenant.stream_deap_mismatch: The DEAP employee ID and the digital employee UID are not the same person: DEAP returned a different account. Check both under Fill in.
